queries.query: Large Language Models AND ("network operations" OR NetOps OR "network configuration" OR "network management")
queries.rationale: Locate core work applying LLMs/foundation models to NetOps problems (generation, planning, orchestration, AIOps).

queries.query: "natural language" TO ("network configuration" OR "intent-to-configuration" OR "intent-based networking" OR YANG OR Ansible OR Netconf)
queries.rationale: Find papers and systems that translate operator intent / NL to concrete network configs or IaC artifacts.

queries.query: "generate-validate-repair" OR "generate-validate" OR "LLM" AND (Batfish OR Veriflow OR "Header Space Analysis" OR NetKAT)
queries.rationale: Identify tool-assisted architectures combining LLM generation with deterministic network validators or repair loops.

queries.query: "network verification" OR "formal verification" "Header Space Analysis" OR NetKAT OR model checking AND (policy compliance OR reachability OR isolation)
queries.rationale: Collect established formal/deterministic validators and metrics used to assert configuration correctness.

queries.query: LLM OR "large language model" AND ("self-correction" OR "iterative repair" OR "tool use" OR "chain of thought" OR ReAct OR Toolformer) AND (network OR configuration)
queries.rationale: Survey LLM self-correction, tool-augmented reasoning, and iterative repair techniques applicable to NetOps.

queries.query: "agentic" OR "autonomous agent" OR "Auto-GPT" OR "LangChain" OR "multi-agent" AND (network OR NetOps OR "network operations")
queries.rationale: Find work using agent frameworks and orchestrators for operational workflows and their failure/safety analyses.

queries.query: "LLM hallucination" OR "prompt injection" OR "adversarial prompt" AND (network OR NetOps OR configuration OR operator)
queries.rationale: Collect research on LLM failure modes, adversarial inputs, and operational safety risks relevant to NetOps.

queries.query: "AIOps" OR "OpsEval" OR "6G-Bench" OR "TSNBench" OR "network benchmark" AND (dataset OR evaluation OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Locate existing benchmarks, datasets, and evaluation suites for AIOps/NetOps and inspect their applicability and gaps.

queries.query: "network configuration dataset" OR "configuration corpus" OR "topology dataset" (CAIDA OR "Internet Topology Zoo" OR "RIPE" OR "RouteViews")
queries.rationale: Find public datasets and topology corpora usable to create realistic NetOps evaluation tasks or simulators.

queries.query: "evaluation metrics" AND (reachability OR isolation OR policy compliance OR loop-freeness OR performance) AND (network OR configuration)
queries.rationale: Collect operational metrics used to measure correctness and risk of network changes and configurations.

queries.query: "fuzzing" OR "mutation testing" OR "fault injection" OR "perturbation testing" AND (network OR NetOps OR configuration)
queries.rationale: Identify robustness-testing methods and fault-injection frameworks applicable to NetOps and LLM-generated artifacts.

queries.query: "Mininet" OR "ns-3" OR Containerlab OR GNS3 OR CORE AND (simulation OR emulation OR testbed) AND (network operations OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Coverage of simulators/emulators and testbeds for validating config changes and running reproducible NetOps experiments.

queries.query: "benchmark validity" OR "external validity" OR "dataset bias" AND (LLM OR AIOps OR NetOps OR evaluation)
queries.rationale: Find meta-research on benchmark design, representativeness, and threats to validity focusing on operational realism.

queries.query: "human-in-the-loop" OR "operator-in-the-loop" OR "change management" OR "network change" AND (validation OR approval OR rollback)
queries.rationale: Survey human oversight patterns, deployment controls, and acceptance tests used in operational NetOps workflows.

queries.query: "autonomous experiments" OR "AI-generated research" OR "autonomous scientific" AND (disclosure OR reproducibility OR provenance OR ethics)
queries.rationale: Locate guidelines and prior work on disclosure, provenance, and reproducibility for autonomous AI-driven research and manuscripts.

inclusion_criteria: Recent arXiv preprints with clear methods, code or dataset links, and verifiable authorship
Project documentation and reproducible code repositories (GitHub/GitLab) for tools/simulators/validators
Public datasets and topology corpora (CAIDA, Internet Topology Zoo, RIPE, RouteViews)
Works that concretely evaluate NetOps artifacts (configs, policies, reachability) or supply validators/emulators
Foundational networking verification literature (even if older) that provides validators/metrics
exclusion_criteria: Unattributed blog posts, marketing materials, or vendor promotional content without verifiable methods or artifacts
Content that depends on proprietary private datasets or closed-source tools not publicly accessible
Benchmarks or LLM QA papers focused only on general networking trivia (not operational NetOps workflows)
Any pre-lock internal development artifact from the programme (must not be used as evidence)
Non-verifiable claims lacking authorship, date, or stable identifier
date_rationale: Search window emphasizes recent LLM and AIOps work (roughly 2018–2026) while retaining older foundational network-verification literature (pre-2018) as needed. This balances capturing rapid advances in foundation models and agentic workflows with established deterministic validators and operational metrics.
